title: Summer Lasagna
description: This creative summer lasagna recipe swaps in thin ribbons of zucchini for carb-heavy noodles. Bet your dinner guests won’t even notice the difference!
ingredients: 5 medium zucchini, sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick strips.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a medium baking dish.

Cook and stir ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Add tomato sauce, onion, bell pepper, carrots, garlic, oregano, basil, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Mix cottage cheese and egg together in a small bowl until well combined.

Layer 1/2 of the zucchini strips in the bottom of the prepared baking dish, then spread cottage cheese mixture over top. Layer with 1/2 of the beef mixture, then 1/2 of the mozzarella. Layer with remaining zucchini, beef mixture, and mozzarella. Top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Allow to sit for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

video.description: This lasagna may be low carb, but it’s a full flavor dish complete with all the cheese, sauce, beef and veggies you love. Replace lasagna noodles with nutritious and thinly sliced zucchini—also a great way to reduce that overabundance of zucchini that comes with every summer! Then combine ground beef with onion, bell pepper, carrots, garlic, tomato sauce and spices. Then layer everything with cottage, mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Bake it up bubbly and delicious and serve to widespread acclaim!
